title: CW URI, QR, Clipboard, and Share Format
negative_results: a private token in the vector, namespace, note, or a percent-encoded URI component is refused (personal data never in a URL)
a wrong URI scheme is refused
a URI missing the frame or epoch query parameter is refused
a path that is not /<codec>/<vector> is refused
a CwUri without a CRS (frame) or epoch is refused at construction (invariant 9)

claims.statement: cw://<namespace>/<codec>/<vector>?frame=..&epoch=.. round-trips through format_cw_uri/parse_cw_uri with the payload preserved through percent-encoding; the CRS and epoch travel with the link; the clipboard block is deterministic and carries no tracking parameter (POWER).
QR is optional: make_qr emits a QR only if the third-party 'qrcode' package imports, otherwise returns available=False with the URI string and a QR_UNAVAILABLE note; no hard dependency is added.
Any share string carrying personal/private data is refused before emission.

privacy_check: CLEAN - URIs scanned raw and decoded, no tracking parameters, no private inputs; qrcode not installed in the build (QR path degrades gracefully)
